description: Single source of truth for SEND/year/subject vocabulary. Extract the subject, year-group, SEND-need, target-area, tone, attainment, and pronoun option lists into client/src/lib/tool-vocab.ts and migrate inline definitions in QuizGenerator, SmartTargets, RubricGenerator, LessonPlanner, ExitTicket, ReportComments, ParentNewsletter, and PupilPassport to import from it. Also adds the previously-missing 'Pathological Demand Avoidance' and 'Complex Needs' SEND options.
steps: Create client/src/lib/tool-vocab.ts exporting SUBJECTS_ALL, SUBJECTS_PRIMARY, SUBJECTS_WITH_OVERALL, YEAR_GROUPS, SEND_NEEDS, TARGET_AREAS, TONES_REPORT, TONES_NEWSLETTER, PRONOUNS, ATTAINMENT_LEVELS — each as { value: string; label: string }[].
Add 'Pathological Demand Avoidance' and 'Complex Needs' to SEND_NEEDS so they are available everywhere a SEND-need select is rendered.
Migrate QuizGenerator.tsx to import SUBJECTS_PRIMARY/YEAR_GROUPS via aliased renames (subjects/years).
Migrate ReportComments.tsx to use SUBJECTS_WITH_OVERALL (preserves the Overall Progress / Form Tutor option), YEAR_GROUPS, ATTAINMENT_LEVELS, TONES_REPORT.
acceptance_criteria: tool-vocab.ts is the only place subject/year/SEND-need lists are defined.
Adding a new SEND need requires a single edit in tool-vocab.ts.
Existing tool behaviour is unchanged for users.
TypeScript syntax check passes on every migrated tool.
verification: Visual inspection of each migrated tool's form.
findings: Verified by --noResolve TS syntax checks on all migrated tools (zero new errors versus main). No build/test commands available due to INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode.
